en:2120949113013329981,21209505686174803.summary: All four latest posts are from the Ministry of Interior on 12 Nov 2026, covering security and traffic enforcement. - 12 Nov: A security news update reports 3 suspects arrested in two cases involving trafficking and use of the narcotic chemical; a 3-day security campaign in Hawalli Governorate resulted in 928 procedures, arrests of wanted persons and violators, and 3 violators referred to Central Prison for reckless driving. - 12 Nov: A road safety reminder says exceeding the permitted load endangers the road and its users, and urges drivers to cover and secure their loads. - 12 Nov: Traffic Department arrested 3 violators for reckless driving, referred them to Central Prison, and impounded two vehicles and a motorcycle. - 12 Nov: The Traffic and Operations Affairs Sector reports arrests of wanted persons and violators and recorded several traffic violations during a joint security and traffic campaign in Kabd area.

ar:2120950568617480363,21209520310412331.summary: أنشطة أمنية ومرورية متنوعة خلال يوم 12 نوفمبر 2026. - 12 نوفمبر: في «أخبار أمنية» ضبط 3 متهمين في قضيتين تتعلقان بالاتجار بمادة الكيميكال المخدرة وتعاطيها، وحملة أمنية في حولي استمرت 3 أيام أسفرت عن 928 إجراءً، وضبط مطلوبين ومخالفين في حملة أمنية ومرورية بمنطقة كبد، وإحالة 3 مخالفين إلى السجن المركزي بسبب الاستهتار والرعونة وكبس مركبتين. - 12 نوفمبر: تذكير بأن تجاوز الحمولة المصرح بها خطر على الطريق، ويجب تغطية الحمولة وإحكام تثبيتها. - 12 نوفمبر: الإدارة العامة للمرور تضبط 3 مخالفين لارتكابهم أعمال الاستهتار والرعونة وتحيلهم إلى السجن المركزي، وتكبس مركبتين ودراجة آلية.

en:676222fa:2120949113013329981,21209505.summary:
All four latest posts are from the Ministry of Interior on 12 Nov 2026, covering security operations and traffic enforcement. 
- 12 Nov: Security news reports 3 suspects arrested in two drug cases, and a 3-day security campaign in Hawalli Governorate led to 928 procedures, plus arrests of wanted persons and violators.
- 12 Nov: A traffic awareness post warns that exceeding the permitted load endangers the road and urges drivers to cover and secure their loads.
- 12 Nov: The General Traffic Department arrested 3 violators for reckless driving, referred them to the Central Prison, and impounded two vehicles and a motorcycle.
- 12 Nov: A joint security and traffic campaign in the Kabd area led to arrests of wanted persons and violators and recorded several traffic violations.

en:676222fa:2120955382625411116.summary: The latest post from the Ministry of Interior account reports security news from 12 Nov 2026. 12 Nov: 3 suspects were arrested in two cases involving trafficking in and use of the narcotic chemical (Kimikal). A 3-day security campaign in Hawalli Governorate resulted in 928 procedures, including the arrest of wanted persons and violators. A security and traffic campaign in the Kabd area led to 3 violators being referred to the Central Prison for reckless driving.
